payload.reason: The authors suggest that Twitter data provides better predictions about language inventory due to its broader representation of languages used in urban areas and fewer missing languages compared to web-crawled data.

claims.text: Twitter data has fewer missing languages compared to census data, indicating better representation of local language use.
Twitter captures a significant amount of language use in urban areas, which may correlate with wealthier populations, enhancing its predictive power.
The methodology of collecting tweets avoids bias from language-specific keywords, leading to a more accurate representation of language use.
